problems_and_friction: No protocol was provided, so tooling had to be discovered via clan --help and clan agent-help; the agent-help quick reference made branch-namespace rules clear quickly. The task brief says output mode full-html, but in branch mode shared writes are rejected and a synthesizer merges later, so I chose namespaced patch-data plus patch-decision instead of rendering HTML — a mild ambiguity. Everything else worked first try with no errors.
context_understood: I was one of three parallel agents on a forked .clan branch for a Brightline CRM evaluation, tasked with contributing a GDPR/lock-in/migration/hidden-cost/support risk analysis plus a risk register, recommended_vendor and confidence_1_5 into my agents/risk-analyst/ namespace for a later merge.
